billing_deploy_plan_change.name: billing_deploy_plan_change
billing_deploy_plan_change.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Changing a customer's billing plan alters a price and can issue an invoice; it is quarantined pending a named provider, verified proration semantics, readback evidence and per-call human authorization. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented.

billing_generate_revops_report.name: billing_generate_revops_report
billing_generate_revops_report.description: Compute MRR, ARR, churn and ARPA from a caller-supplied subscription list. All money is integer minor units (amount_minor); floats are rejected. currency and period are mandatory. Annualisation uses the explicit interval field ('month' or 'year'), never the plan name. Returns ok=true with evidence marked unverified for caller-supplied data — this is arithmetic, not reconciliation.

billing_get_alerts.name: billing_get_alerts
billing_get_alerts.description: Return billing alerts from the alert engine. None is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty list that could be read as 'nothing flagged'.

billing_get_audit_log.name: billing_get_audit_log
billing_get_audit_log.description: Return billing audit entries from the audit store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty log that could be read as 'clean'.

billing_get_budget_metrics.name: billing_get_budget_metrics
billing_get_budget_metrics.description: Return the billing agent's budget window from the budget store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never invents a limit.

billing_import_ar_ledger.name: billing_import_ar_ledger
billing_import_ar_ledger.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Importing an AR ledger is quarantined pending named provider credentials, a real destination table and readback evidence. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented and rows_inserted 0.

code_format.name: code_format
code_format.description: Format code via black or prettier. Returns formatted content or the original on error.

commerce_configure_tax_engine.name: commerce_configure_tax_engine
commerce_configure_tax_engine.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Tax-engine configuration determines the tax on every future invoice and is quarantined pending a named provider and an accountant-approved rule set. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented. No tax configuration is created.

commerce_get_alerts.name: commerce_get_alerts
commerce_get_alerts.description: Return commerce alerts from the alert engine. None is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty list that could be read as 'nothing flagged'.

commerce_get_audit_log.name: commerce_get_audit_log
commerce_get_audit_log.description: Return commerce audit entries from the audit store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty log that could be read as 'clean'.

commerce_get_budget_metrics.name: commerce_get_budget_metrics
commerce_get_budget_metrics.description: Return the commerce agent's budget window from the budget store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never invents a limit.

conduit.name: conduit
conduit.description: Restricted browser navigation, search, extraction, screenshots, clicking, text entry, and accessibility snapshots. Private/local URLs and arbitrary JavaScript execution are denied.

data_bigquery_query.name: data_bigquery_query
data_bigquery_query.description: Run a BigQuery SQL query. Scaffold pending Phase 9 GCP credentials.

data_dbt_compile.name: data_dbt_compile
data_dbt_compile.description: Compile a dbt model SQL with refs. Scaffold - requires dbt CLI (Phase 9).

data_get_editor_context.name: data_get_editor_context
data_get_editor_context.description: Returns what the user is currently looking at or focusing on in the IDE, including active file path, open SQL code/content, highlighted lines, or open cloud webview resource URIs (bq://..., gcs://..., spark://...).

data_get_gcp_connection.name: data_get_gcp_connection
data_get_gcp_connection.description: Inspects active Google Cloud connection details, project ID, and authentication state.

data_list_resource_templates.name: data_list_resource_templates
data_list_resource_templates.description: Lists available cloud resource URI templates (BigQuery bq://, GCS gcs://, Spark spark://, Lakehouse lakehouse://).

data_pipeline_design.name: data_pipeline_design
data_pipeline_design.description: Produce a structured ETL pipeline design (extract / transform / load / validate). Design-only output - no execution. Heuristically chooses methods based on source and destination.

data_quality_check.name: data_quality_check
data_quality_check.description: Run in-process data quality checks against a list of row dicts. Performs null checks, type checks (string/number/boolean/date), and named rules (not_null, positive, unique, not_empty). Returns a summary with completeness_score_pct, total_issues, per-field issue list, and a passed boolean. Returns an error if data is empty or not provided.

data_read_resource.name: data_read_resource
data_read_resource.description: Reads metadata and schema definition for a specified cloud resource URI (e.g. 'bq://my-project/my_dataset/my_table' or 'gcs://my-bucket/path/data.parquet').

data_s3_signed_url.name: data_s3_signed_url
data_s3_signed_url.description: Generate a pre-signed S3 URL. Scaffold pending Phase 9 AWS credentials.

domain_check_availability.name: domain_check_availability
domain_check_availability.description: Batch-check domain availability via Name.com when NAMECOM_USERNAME+NAMECOM_TOKEN env vars are set; returns a scaffold response otherwise.

domain_configure_dns.name: domain_configure_dns
domain_configure_dns.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Writing DNS records requires a credentialed registrar/DNS provider and zone readback. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented.

domain_generate_candidates.name: domain_generate_candidates
domain_generate_candidates.description: Generate scored domain-name candidates around a theme or business name. Returns a ranked list with score/tld/length/memorable/brandable per candidate.

domain_get_cost_summary.name: domain_get_cost_summary
domain_get_cost_summary.description: Return domain cost totals from the registry store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never reports a zero cost or an empty domain list as fact.

file_write.name: file_write
file_write.description: Write a file to the job's ephemeral storage. Path must be relative to the job dir.

finance_generate_finance_report.name: finance_generate_finance_report
finance_generate_finance_report.description: Compute a P&L from a caller-supplied transaction list. All money is integer minor units (amount_minor); floats are rejected. currency, period and source are mandatory and have no defaults. Mixed currencies are rejected, never summed. Expenses group by an explicit category field. Returns ok=true with evidence marked unverified for caller-supplied data — this is arithmetic, not reconciliation.

finance_get_alerts.name: finance_get_alerts
finance_get_alerts.description: Return finance alerts from the alert engine. None is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty list that could be read as 'nothing flagged'.

finance_get_audit_log.name: finance_get_audit_log
finance_get_audit_log.description: Return finance audit entries from the audit store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty log that could be read as 'clean'.

finance_get_budget_metrics.name: finance_get_budget_metrics
finance_get_budget_metrics.description: Return the finance agent's budget window from the budget store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never invents a limit.

finance_import_x402_transactions.name: finance_import_x402_transactions
finance_import_x402_transactions.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Bulk-importing x402 ledger entries is quarantined pending a real ledger table with a uniqueness index and post-insert readback. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented and rows_inserted 0. It never reports len(input) as a row count.

finance_sync_bank_fees.name: finance_sync_bank_fees
finance_sync_bank_fees.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Recording bank fees to the general ledger is quarantined pending a credentialed Xero integration, statement-line reconciliation and readback evidence. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented. No ledger entry is created.

genesis_call.name: genesis_call
genesis_call.description: Dispatch a task to another Genesis agent by slug. Used by orchestrator agents to delegate specialist work.

github_tool.name: github_tool
github_tool.description: GitHub repository operations. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var. Actions: create_repo, push_file, get_file, list_repos, create_branch.

hr_bamboohr_query.name: hr_bamboohr_query
hr_bamboohr_query.description: Query BambooHR for employee records, time off, or reports. Scaffold pending Phase 9 OAuth.

hr_greenhouse_query.name: hr_greenhouse_query
hr_greenhouse_query.description: Query Greenhouse ATS for candidates, jobs, or applications. Scaffold pending Phase 9 OAuth.

hr_lever_query.name: hr_lever_query
hr_lever_query.description: Query Lever ATS for candidates, postings, or opportunities. Scaffold pending Phase 9 OAuth.

hr_template_generate.name: hr_template_generate
hr_template_generate.description: Generate a markdown HR document template. Supports offer_letter, policy_update, onboarding_checklist, termination_letter. Provided context values are substituted; any remaining placeholders are reported in missing_placeholders.

pricing_deploy_pricing_update.name: pricing_deploy_pricing_update
pricing_deploy_pricing_update.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Pushing a price change is quarantined pending a named channel provider, price readback evidence and per-call human authorization. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented.

pricing_get_alerts.name: pricing_get_alerts
pricing_get_alerts.description: Return pricing alerts from the alert engine. None is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty list that could be read as 'nothing flagged'.

pricing_get_audit_log.name: pricing_get_audit_log
pricing_get_audit_log.description: Return pricing audit entries from the audit store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never returns an empty log that could be read as 'clean'.

pricing_get_budget_metrics.name: pricing_get_budget_metrics
pricing_get_budget_metrics.description: Return the pricing agent's budget window from the budget store. No store is wired, so this always returns ok=false with error.code=provider_unconfigured. It never invents a limit.

pricing_run_elasticity_experiment.name: pricing_run_elasticity_experiment
pricing_run_elasticity_experiment.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Running a live price-elasticity experiment changes what real customers are charged and is quarantined pending a named provider and per-call human authorization. Always returns ok=false with error.code=not_implemented.

run_code.name: run_code
run_code.description: Execute Python code in an isolated subprocess with no network access and a maximum timeout of 30s. Max code length: 10000 characters. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

screenshot_url.name: screenshot_url
screenshot_url.description: Take a PNG screenshot of a URL using a headless browser. Returns base64-encoded image.

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Send an email. Uses SendGrid if SENDGRID_API_KEY is set, otherwise falls back to SMTP (SMTP_HOST + SMTP_USER + SMTP_PASS).

vision_analyze.name: vision_analyze
vision_analyze.description: Answer a question about an image using GPT-4o vision.

vision_compare.name: vision_compare
vision_compare.description: Compare two images for similarities and differences using GPT-4o vision.

vision_ocr.name: vision_ocr
vision_ocr.description: Extract all text from an image using GPT-4o vision OCR.

web_fetch.name: web_fetch
web_fetch.description: Fetch a URL and return its text content (HTML stripped by default).

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Search the web for a query. Uses Serper API if SERPER_API_KEY is set, otherwise falls back to DuckDuckGo.

workflow_make_export.name: workflow_make_export
workflow_make_export.description: Generate a Make (Integromat) scenario blueprint. Scaffold - deferred to Phase 9.

workflow_n8n_export.name: workflow_n8n_export
workflow_n8n_export.description: Generate an importable n8n workflow JSON from a description.

workflow_webhook_trigger.name: workflow_webhook_trigger
workflow_webhook_trigger.description: POST a JSON payload to an https:// webhook URL. 10s timeout. Refuses non-https URLs.

workflow_zapier_export.name: workflow_zapier_export
workflow_zapier_export.description: Generate an importable Zapier-style workflow template from a description.

workspace_shell.name: workspace_shell
workspace_shell.description: Run a shell command inside the job workspace (/tmp/jobs/{job_id}/workspace/). Max timeout: 60s. Max output: 64KB. Commands that escape the workspace, delete system files, or expose secrets are blocked. Use for: running tests, lint, build commands, npm install, pytest, etc.
